_provenance: Tissue composition for the Rodgers & Rowland partition method (Rodgers, Leahy & Rowland 2005, J Pharm Sci 94:1259; Rodgers & Rowland 2006, J Pharm Sci 95:1238).

Fractional volumes (f_nl neutral lipid, f_np neutral phospholipid, f_ew extracellular water, f_iw intracellular water) and tissue:plasma albumin/lipoprotein ratios: rat composition corrected for residual blood, applied to human as in Rodgers & Rowland 2007, transcribed from Coutinho et al. 2024 Table III (open access, CC BY 4.0). Adipose f_nl/f_np use the corrected (non-swapped) order.

Acidic phospholipids (ap, mg/g) and erythrocyte composition: transcribed from the Huisinga et al. 2012 supplement (GenericPBPKmodel_physiology.m), citing Rodgers, Leahy & Rowland 2005 and Rodgers & Rowland 2007 Table VII; pancreas ap uses the gut value (no source).
pH values and the vegetable oil:water relation for adipose (log Pvo = 1.115 log P - 1.35): Yau et al. 2020.

Values copied from the provenance-annotated compilation in matthiaskoenig/pkpdsim (src/pkpdsim/pbpk/data/tissue_composition.toml, commit bc9ef0c); none re-verified against the 2005/2006 originals, which are paywalled.
